text:
maria: Heads-up — we need GPU quota increases in eu-west-15 for a new partner org (acme-edge). Can someone open a ticket with AWS for p5/p4d/g5 and also check ENI/NAT limits?
rohan: +1. Can you paste exact counts and a short business justification? I can draft the support case.
maria: Sure — they plan to run mixed training + low-latency inference. Start of production in ~3 weeks. Requesting: 
```
- p5.48xlarge: increase from 0 -> 12 (training-heavy batch jobs)
- p4d.24xlarge: increase from 0 -> 6 (some legacy training kernels)
- g5.48xlarge: increase from 0 -> 20 (inference pools & canary)
- ENIs / IPv4 addresses per account: request bump to allow 100 ENIs across subnets
- NAT gateway throughput / elastic IPs: increase egress capacity for heavy model downloads
```
maria: Business justification: commercial partner doing large-scale model finetuning + production inference. Will generate ~4M tokens/day initially, expected to grow. Contract signed, named customer, SLA required.
rohan: Ok. Two operational q's: 1) do we want these as on-demand or reserved for Dedicated capacity? 2) which AWS accounts (org IDs) to include in the case?
maria: Start on-demand in partner sandbox account + our shared infra account for canaries. Later move to Dedicated for steady traffic. Accounts: 123456789012 (partner-sandbox), 210987654321 (redwood-canary).
jen: Cost note: p5/p4d on-demand is expensive. Recommend gating full g5 pool until we confirm burst profile. Maybe request lower initial g5 (8) and include a scale plan in the ticket. Finance prefers staged increases.
priya: Also check subnet IP availability in eu-west-15 — some AZs have tight /24s. If IPv4 scarcity, ask support about IPv6 fallback or additional private IPv4 pool.
diego: For the support case, include workload profile: average GPUs needed concurrently, peak hours, and whether spot is allowed. If partner requires SLA, we should request quota on on-demand and express need for deterministic capacity.
rohan: Drafting support case now. I'll include the staged g5 ask (8 -> 20) and note Dedicated transition. Will tag AWS account IDs and attach contract excerpt.
rohan: Draft excerpt: 
```
We request quota increases in eu-west-15 to support onboarding of a commercial partner (ACME Edge). Initial needs: p5:12, p4d:6, g5:8 (staged to 20). Purpose: mixed finetune + inference. Accounts: 123456789012, 210987654321. Need ENI bump to 100 and guidance on IPv4 exhaustion fallback (IPv6 preferred). Business-critical: 3 week timeline.
```
jen: Add estimated monthly cost range to speed approvals: conservative on-demand burn ~ $420k/month peak (if fully utilized) — include a note we'll move to reserved / Dedicated when stable.
priya: Also request NAT gateway quota/throughput increases and ask if AWS can pre-validate subnets for ENI placement. Saves back-and-forth.
infra-bot: support ticket created: #AWSSUP-2026-82431 — assigned to rohan. ETA from AWS: 72-120 hours to respond.
aws-support-bot: Acknowledged. Please provide account verification docs and contract excerpt. If IPv4 addresses scarce, consider requesting Elastic IP pool or enable IPv6; lead time varies.
maria: Posting contract excerpt now in private doc and DMing rohan. Thanks all — once ticket is ACKed we'll schedule a brief runbook review for canary deploys.
rohan: Will follow up in the ticket and ping here when we have AWS confirmation. If we get partial quotas, we may prioritize p5+p4d for training and ramp g5 gradually.
jen: Tagging billing to pre-approve emergency spend for the first 2 weeks if needed.
priya: I'll pre-check subnets and post results by EOD.
diego: If AWS pushes back on immediate increases, propose an interim plan: 4 p5 + 2 p4d + 8 g5 reserved for critical runs and use region fallback to eu-west-3 for overflow.
maria: Good contingency. Thanks everyone.
rohan: closing loop — ticket number and next steps will be added to the onboarding checklist.
